messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt started for release/2026.03.20. Job: release-prod -> promoting canary

deploy-bot: Error: checksum mismatch when fetching artifact `redwood-runtime-1.12.0.tar.gz` from gs://redwood-artifacts/releases/2026/03/20/

sarah.kim: wait, checksum mismatch? expected sha256:aaa111 got sha256:bbb222

mike: saw this once after we bumped setuptools metadata. CI showed flaky `TestUpgradePath.test_cache_invalidation` earlier in the pipeline.

priya: can someone reproduce local build + checksum? try: `./scripts/build-package.sh && sha256sum dist/redwood-runtime-1.12.0.tar.gz`

jason: I ran that on my macbook, got sha256:aaa111 (matches expected). so upload path might be corrupted or GCS returned a partial object due to resumable upload.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @priya - restarting release-prod pipeline (attempt #2)

mike: rerun still returns sha256:bbb222 from GCS. listing object versions shows an older object at the same path with different hash.

sarah.kim: options during change window (40m left): 1) revert packaging bump (clean start), 2) pin manifest to existing good hash (quick patch), 3) try forcing re-upload.

elena: ops note: forcing re-upload could lead to a race where some regions read old object until caches invalidate. revert is safest for global consistency.

priya: agree with revert. I'll open a revert PR and cut hotfix branch.

jason: PR #4123 opened: `hotfix/revert-packaging-bump-2026-03-20`. CI triggered.

mike: CI on hotfix: unit + integration green. canary promotion recommended.

deploy-bot: Hotfix pipeline succeeded on `hotfix/revert-packaging-bump-2026-03-20`. Canopy window still open (20m).

sarah.kim: promoting hotfix to canary now, will monitor for 10m then promote to prod if stable. @oncall-eng please monitor logs and GCS integrity.

elena: watching. adding temporary alert to catch checksum mismatches and `TestUpgradePath` regressions.

ci-bot: Promotion to prod completed successfully.

sarah.kim: follow-ups: 1) add pre-publish checksum verification and abort on mismatch, 2) triage `TestUpgradePath` flakes, 3) audit artifact upload/resumable logic for GCS. I'll add to sprint and write release note blurb: "reverted packaging bump; investigation ongoing." 

mike: will take ownership of pre-publish verification. opening issue.

elena: :thumbsup: closing thread.
